title: Sneap peak on my cozy workshop puzzle game
author: DamnrightWorldsDev
selftext:
Hi everyone,

I’ll go ahead and show you what I’ve been working on. “Craft Flow” is basically about this:

You’re getting your great-aunt’s old workshop up and running again. The main gameplay is the puzzle. You sort parts, finish them by hand, and use them to rebuild your great-aunt’s old workshop. Pottery, candles, bookbinding. On the iPhone, there’s real haptic feedback, so every crafting action feels unique. Sounds and such are all CC0, so they’re real sounds. Graphics were created with Codex and then reworked by hand.

I’ve also included the full accessibility package: VoiceOver, large text, bold outlines, etc.

The release is now scheduled for November. It’s currently in the iOS review queue (which is taking forever right now). Will be available for iPhone and iPad.

Feedback appreciated.
